region.description: Checked against the credentials' region when set.

launch_type.description: For one-off tasks (release, run, console). Default FARGATE; ignored when capacity_provider_strategy is set.

template.description: Task definition ARN (or family:revision) every deploy copies, changing only the image.

family.description: The family ecsd registers into, when it isn't the template's. In the template's family, a template your infrastructure registers is the newest revision until the next deploy, so it's what starts for anything that runs tasks by family name.

service.description: Services only: the ECS service's name, when it isn't the key.

network.description: Tasks only: overrides the manifest's network.

services.description: Services ecsd rolls, by name. Each must exist, and ignore task definition changes in whatever manages it.

network.description: Tasks only: overrides the manifest's network.

tasks.description: Task families ecsd registers on every deploy without a service: one-off tasks, consoles, tasks an app starts itself.

network.description: For one-off tasks. Defaults to the first service's.

hosts.description: Base URLs or host names, substituted as written for ${hosts.<name>} in health and smoke checks.

title: ecsd stage manifest
description: Where ecsd deploys, written by the infrastructure to an SSM parameter (default /<app>/<stage>/deploy).
